name: Gitea
description: A self-hosted Git service with pull requests, issues and CI hooks. SSH is a direct port because the proxy cannot carry the Git SSH protocol.

access.note: Gitea ships with no accounts and no default password. Because the image leaves INSTALL_LOCK false, the very first page you open is Gitea's own installer: it pre-fills the database (SQLite inside the data volume) and its "Administrator Account Settings" section is where you create the owner. Open the address immediately after the deploy finishes, because whoever reaches the installer first configures and owns the server.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Gitea writes this into clone URLs, so changing it later rewrites what users copy.

ports.name: ssh
ports.purpose: Git over SSH, which a reverse proxy cannot carry

update.notes: Gitea migrates its database on first start after an upgrade and does not migrate back. Settings this definition does not pass as environment are changed in Gitea's own Site Administration pages.
